observations.observation: Gold/blue airbrushed pharaonic figures, floating pyramids, outlined decorated TELEPATHY and light STEP IN TIME, compact white date/venue footer. Highly specific Egyptian imagery retained as a documented variant, not generic required ornament or a motif to casually copy.

media.handling: Linked analysis only; interview reproduction, underlying artist copyright, no reuse permission established. No downloads or republication.
media.inspection_notes: Complete standalone original reproduction from practitioner interview inspected individually. Media native dimensions measured. No historical motion claims from still; no gallery/contact sheet count.

media.title: RAW opening-night invitation photographed with pill-like objects — contextual boundary
media.creator: George Georgiou

observations.observation: Small folded ticket with turquoise italic RAW across black bar, dashed fold/perforation line, row of dots and handwritten-like invitation details on plain stock, photographed alongside capsule shapes. This photographed arrangement is not a universal rave graphic system.

media.handling: Linked analysis only; collector photography, no reuse license established. No downloads or republication.
media.inspection_notes: Complete artist photograph inspected. Early club ephemera is relevant context, but this isolated invitation does not independently establish the scoped acid-house/rave event boundary; excluded rather than padding corpus.
